description: Willow's own pages, answered by the app on Windows and by its local server elsewhere: the folder picker and the Willow folder they save into, notifications, closing the window (Ctrl+W) and reporting where the page is, the frame's colour and Labs' choice of window buttons, the strip's menus drawn over the page (opening and closing them, their Edit and zoom keys, full screen, Quit), the right-click menu's answer, the pet — its overlay window, the pet library, and the paw's state — /llm-proxy read as it streams, and the agents' server for the agent tabs (its address, and opening it to the network or Tailscale) and their count of threads waiting on the taskbar, and the agents' window captures (their shortcut, once turned on in the agents' settings, and the captures waiting for the composer), and the agents' browser tabs laid over the page, and the agents' side-panel tabs it hands the strip to draw. Nothing else crosses into native code. Willow's page only: the browser tabs' webviews, in the same window, show other sites and get none of this.
